events.verdict: Zeller (CHA) makes contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm and affects his shot attempt near the rim.
Monk (CHA) makes marginal contact with Covington (PHI) as he slips the pick.
Monk (CHA) gathers the ball and takes two legal steps during his spin move.
Zeller (CHA) is firming up in a picking position in Embiid's (PHI) path when contact occurs and does not prevent him from disengaging from the contact.
Walker (CHA) briefly places two incidental hands on Redick (PHI) as he cuts.
RAR shows Zeller (CHA) is not in a legal guarding position and makes contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm. Arm contact occurs prior to contact with Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA).
Covington (PHI) makes incidental contact with Zeller (CHA) that does not affect his ability to get to the loose ball.
Zeller (CHA) does not attempt a shot before the shot clock's expiration.
Bacon (CHA) defends Saric (PHI) with two hands but does not affect his FOM.
Redick (PHI) sets the screen in Zeller's (CHA) path and arm contact occurs that does not affect Zeller's FOM.
[Observable in enhanced video] Embid switches pivot feet during this face up move on the perimeter.
All available angles show Walker (CHA) does not make contact with Embiid's (PHI) arm during his shooting motion on his jump shot attempt.
Embiid (PHI) makes contact with Walker's (CHA) head during the driving shot attempt.
Zeller (CHA) engages Embiid (PHI) with two hands and affects his ability to get to the pass.
[Observable in enhanced video] Simmons (PHI) is in the paint without actively guarding an opponent for more than three seconds.
Covington (PHI) makes marginal contact with Walker's (CHA) body during his driving shot attempt.
Walker's (CHA) shot attempt as the shot clock expires does not make contact with the rim.
Walker (CHA) legally contests Redick's (PHI) shot attempt at the buzzer.
Walker (CHA) briefly grasps Embiid (PHI) but does not affect his FOM.
Saric (PHI) is not in a legal guarding position when he makes more than marginal contact with Monk's (CHA) body during his shot attempt near the rim.
Redick (PHI) sets the screen in Biyombo's (CHA) path and absorbs contact.
Biyombo (CHA) engages with Embiid (PHI) in the post and affects his FOM.
Covington (PHI) makes incidental contact with Monk's (CHA) arm during the follow-through on his jump shot attempt.
Bridges (CHA) makes marginal contact with Simmons's (PHI) body that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Covington (PHI) makes marginal contact with Walker's (CHA) body during his driving shot attempt.
Hernangomez (CHA) and Covington (PHI) make incidental contact during the rebound.
LAR shows Bridges (CHA) makes contact with the ball after it has exited the cylinder.
Saric (PHI) makes marginal contact with Bridges's (CHA) arm that does not affect his shot attempt near the rim.
[Observable in enhanced video] Embiid (PHI) does not fully step out of bounds before inbounding the ball.
Embiid (PHI) sets the screen in Monk's (CHA) path and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Bridges (CHA) briefly engages with Simmons (PHI) at the start of his drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Biyombo (CHA) jumps A to B and makes contact with Simmons' (PHI) body that affects his driving shot attempt.
Simmons (PHI) cleanly blocks Walker's (CHA) jump shot attempt.
Hernangomez (CHA) and Embiid (PHI) make incidental foot contact during the rebound.
Kidd-Gilchrist (CHA) commits a take foul on Embiid (PHI).
Embiid (PHI) makes incidental contact with Walker (CHA) at the end of his dribble.
Embiid (PHI) makes incidental contact with Hernangomez's (CHA) body during the follow-through on his jump shot attempt.
